dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm... So it's still too much? But this dish doesn't taste any good if left to cool for too long...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you're here! Kirara just delivered a bunch of fresh fish from Inazuma.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I was just thinking that since she came all this way, I should make some piping-hot Liyue cuisine for her! After all, "a bit of heat is worth three fresh ingredients"!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: So... hah... so good! Hah, hot... So, so good... mreow! Hothothothot!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Please, don't feel obligated! We've got plenty of cold dishes here in Liyue, too! I can whip one up for you!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: But this boiled fish really is delicious! I... I want to try some more...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Haaa... Haa... Phew... Cold water... soak it in some cold water... Cool it off first...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, she's got a "cat's tongue" after all...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Haiyaa, take it easy! Here, quick! Put this riceball in your mouth! Dad says it helps with the spiciness.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Let me think... What are some good choices for cold dishes...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Wow! This onigiri is great too! Just as delicious as Granny's, sweet and sour...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe, that's a given! I added steamed potatoes and sweet flowers, as well as dried plums and berries... Eh? Why'd you eat it all already!?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: TONGUE! My tongue! It's on fiiiiiire! Hothothothothothot!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It only helps with the spiciness while it's in your mouth! Quick, here's another, and this time, don't just scarf it down!
